4A.
PROJECT NAME: Orpheus Park Improvements CASE NUMBER: MULTI-008207-2025 FILING DATE: July 7, 2025; APPLICANT: Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department, City of Encinitas; LOCATION: 482 Orpheus Avenue (APN: 256-301-05); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a Coastal Development Permit and Substantial Conformance review for various improvements at Orpheus Park including the demolition and installation of a picnic canopy, playground equipment, safety surfacing, fitness equipment, drainage, concrete flatwork, seating and associated site improvements; ZONING/OVERLAY: Ecological Resource/Open Space/Parks (ER/OS/PK) Zone and the Coastal Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Sections 15301 and 15302 which exempts replacement or reconstruction of existing structures and facilities where the new structure will be located on the same site as the structure replaced and will have substantially the same purpose and capacity as the structure replaced;
STAFF CONTACT: Raffi Mangassarian, Senior Planner (760) 633-2703 or rmangassarian@encinitasca.gov.
Staff recommends the item be approved.
ZA Attachment 1 - Staff Report
ZA Attachment 2 - Plans
ZA Attachment 3 - Public Correspondence
4B.
PROJECT NAME: Meardon Residence CASE NUMBER: CDP-008492-2025 FILING DATE: November 12, 2025; APPLICANT: Vince Meardon; LOCATION: 1465 Neptune Avenue (APN: 254-221-38); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a Coastal Development Permit for the demolition of an existing single-family residence and the construction of a new single-family residence with an attached garage and site improvements. The proposed project was approved on November 7, 2023 (CDP-005723-2022), which has since expired. No changes are proposed to the previous approved design of the residence; ZONING/OVERLAY: Residential 11 (R-11) Zone, Special Study Overlay Zone, and the Coastal Commission Appeal Jurisdiction of the Coastal Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review pursuant to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15303 (a) which exempts the new construction of one single-family residence in a residential zone. The project meets these criteria. None of the exceptions in Section 15300.2 of the CEQA Guidelines apply, and no historical resources will be impacted by the proposed development.
STAFF CONTACT: Christina Rios, Associate Planner (760) 633-2794 or crios@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends the item be approved.

ZA Attachment 2 - Plans
